recipes.name: Creamy Parmesan Brussels Sprouts
ingredients_raw: salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees F (150 degrees C). Generously grease a 9x9-inch baking dish with butter.

Spread Brussels sprouts into the prepared baking dish. Whisk cream, Parmesan cheese, garlic, salt, and black pepper together in a bowl until thoroughly combined; pour over Brussels sprouts. Sprinkle with nutmeg.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until tender, about 1 hour. Remove foil; continue baking, uncovered, until top has browned, about 15 minutes more.

raw_recipe.headline: Creamy Parmesan Brussels Sprouts
raw_recipe.description: These easy-to-make Parmesan Brussels sprouts are baked in a rich, creamy sauce until they turn golden brown. Everyone will adore this side dish recipe.

review.reviewBody: My husband and I tried this recipe last night. It took a while to cook, and was well worth it. I have never been a fan of this particular veggie, but have been wanting to expand our veggie repertoire. This recipe helped to accomplish that for me! It smelled wonderful, and the Parmesan cheese and garlic worked wonders for this under-appreciated vegetable. I will make this again! I didn't make any changes. Thank you Christine for submitting this!!
Tasty and I'm not a fan of brussel sprouts. Cook time is far less if you use frozen sprouts. Mine were overcooked after 50min, but I would certainly try again and check them more periodically.
Pretty good. I added a pepper blend and red pepper flakes. I'll probably make again and add sharp cheddar. I also cooked on 350 and 20 min on 300.
Loved this, I roasted them first for about 30 minutes to get them crisp then put them back in the oven with cream and parmesan for about 20 more minutes. Very good!!!
I have made this recipe several times and its always I hit, I usually put some extra cheese on top. I increase the heat to 350 and cook for 90 minutes before I uncover to crisp up the top. Enjoy!
It was perfect when I turned the temperature to 375 degrees for sixty minutes, cut the cream to one cup, and added 1 cup of shredded Swiss cheese during the additional 15 uncovered minutes.

I loved it, made it for family whom not all are fans of brussel sprouts, well they are now,just one little change to recipe and that was to boil sprouts in chicken broth(did not let them get to soft) to take any bitterness out,worked well.

I had this at a friend's house and it was delicious. I went home and made it the very next night. Because fresh sprouts take so long to cook, I boiled them first to soften. Only ended up baking them for about 45 minutes. She also added bacon crumbles on top so I did as well (hey, everything taste better with bacon!)
I've made this several times. I just cut the sprouts in half. Anytime you bake sprouts you always set it to 350 or higher and bake for 45 minutes. Comes out perfect everytime.

This came out delicious! The one thing I didn’t do was add nutmeg at the end, I just didn’t have any. And I used minced garlic from a jar to save a bit of time there. Once I served the dish, I shredded more fresh Parmesan on top. It was a hit, no leftovers. Will definitely make again!!

This was the greatest!! We loved it! I did cook at 350 for an hour and 15 minutes. With the last 15 having the cover off. I did add a bit more garlic as I didn't have actual cloves and just the squirt garlic and squirted too much, but It was wonderful!
This was very delicious

Had this creamy parmesan brussels sprouts at my friends last weekend. Had to have the recipe. Was delicious, highly recommend this recipe. The sprouts were still a little under cooked for me so I would recommend if cooking larger sprouts to cook them longer. Trying them tonight and cooking them 1 1/2 hours as they are large ones. Terry Tillsonburg, ON
Okay this is amazingly delicious but……. 300 degrees did not cook as expected. It actually took an additional 30 minutes at 350 with Brussels sprouts cut in half.
OMG.... I don’t usually leave reviews but these were excellent. I made them just like the recipe said and I will definitely make them again. Yum!

Made this recipe as directed and it turned out delicious! I did bump the oven temperature to 350 because many people said it took longer to bake than the hour and fifteen minutes. It baked up perfectly. The sprouts were on the soft side, which I like and browned nicely those last 15 minutes uncovered. Next time I may bake then a little longer uncovered to brown them more.
It was good but not enough flavor for my family so I added cut up left over highly spiced chicken to it and it was better. I might make it again.
I could not wait to try this right out of the oven! I used 12oz of shaved sprouts. Next time I want to add some chopped artichoke hearts to it. Love this recipe.
I made it as stated in the recipe. Pretty amazing and a definite repeat performance in the future at our house.
Wonderful texture and complimentary flavor to a wide range of entrees.
